aggregation.representation: arithmetic mean of five same-case same-train-size paired candidate/baseline seed ratios; single-field guard uses the maximum ratio over every field and seed
aggregation.quality_regime: arithmetic mean over the five frozen model-fit seeds; smooth high-frequency roughness uses the median over every smooth field and seed
aggregation.cost: equal-weight arithmetic mean of current calc_cost.py objective MAEs before taking the candidate/baseline ratio

derivation.representation_noninferiority: The 5% rawData limit is the practical floor and exceeds two population standard deviations of the paired baseline seed dispersion in this validation block; current-cost receives a 10% limit because nonlinear rawData-to-cost projection has larger baseline seed dispersion.
derivation.single_field_guard: A 25% maximum field-level standardized-RMSE degradation prevents a macro win from hiding a field collapse while allowing finite five-seed variation.
derivation.clean_leakage: The 0.35 ceiling is the best legal validation reference reached by the training-only PCA diagnostic at train=1000; a production predictor must not leak more clean-target high-frequency energy than that reference.
derivation.roughness: A factor-of-two ceiling allows finite reconstruction error but rejects order-of-magnitude high-frequency inflation on smooth targets.
derivation.classifier: AUPRC must reach at least three times the approximately 0.10 smooth prevalence; Brier must beat the approximately 0.09 constant-prevalence score. ECE is a loose uncalibrated diagnostic ceiling; independent probability calibration remains 082609 scope.
derivation.ablation: The final gated residual arm must not increase clean-target leakage relative to shared-latent isolation. All four registered arms remain visible regardless of outcome.
